from collections import Counter
code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    rmin = min(r for r, c in points)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-rmin, c-cmin) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in range(h-sh+1):
        for c0 in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r0+dr][c0+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = marker
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    rmin = min(r for r, c in points)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-rmin, c-cmin) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in range(h-sh+1):
        for c0 in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r0+dr][c0+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = marker
    return out
